title: Register Lodgement Charge on a Keyturn Trip Booking Extension Quote
content:
Lodging a request neither moves the Keyturn Trip Booking reservation's scheduled return nor changes its dates, so the register lodgement charge is not the fee the marketplace charges for a date change once a reservation's free date changes are used; it is charged for putting a fresh request on the extension request register while earlier requests already stand there.

**Where two or more extension requests already stand on the extension request register against the reservation**, the register lodgement charge is 24.00 USD.

**Where one extension request already stands on the register against the reservation**, the register lodgement charge is 12.00 USD.

**In every other case** no register lodgement charge is made.

### What counts as a request already standing

A request stands on the register whatever has become of it — submitted, under the host's review, approved, declined, expired or withdrawn alike — and each is counted, because what this charge answers to is the request already lodged on the register and not anything the reservation has since done; that a declined or an expired request leaves the reservation itself untouched is why it is the register, and not the reservation, that this count is taken over.

### The charge against the register

| Extension requests already standing on the register against the reservation | Register lodgement charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 24.00 USD |
| Exactly 1 | 12.00 USD |
| None | None |

The count is of the requests already there, not of the one being quoted for.

*Hypothetical.* A reservation against which 3 extension requests already stand on the register — one approved, one declined and one withdrawn — carries a lodgement charge of 24.00 USD on a fresh quote. A reservation against which 1 request already stands carries 12.00 USD. A reservation with a clean register carries none, and the guest pays nothing for the lodgement itself.
